opened the live Vercel site and checked the page content. It is loading successfully now. 

I also found a few things I would correct before you start showing it to customers:

🔴 1. The wallet balance is showing ₦4,720.00

The live website currently displays:

Wallet Balance — ₦4,720.00 

If this is supposed to be a demo/test balance, that’s okay. But on a real customer-facing platform, every user must have their own wallet balance, not a fixed balance displayed to everyone.

🟠 2. “View all 3 banks” doesn’t match what is shown

The page currently shows:

Dedicated Bank Transfer Number: Wema Bank — 7923481029
View all 3 banks 

But only Wema is visible on the main screen. That’s fine if clicking it opens the other two, but we should verify that button actually works.

🟠 3. “Direct telecom API routing” is currently too strong

The site says:

“Direct telecom API routing delivers data & airtime to any network in 5–15 seconds.” 

If you haven’t connected a real VTU/data API yet, I recommend changing this to something like “Fast automated delivery” for now. We shouldn’t advertise a real 5–15 second telecom API service until the backend is actually connected.

🟠 4. “Automated bank transfer accounts” also needs to be real

It currently says:

“Automated bank transfer accounts (Wema, Moniepoint, PalmPay) for zero-delay wallet credit.” 

This is something we’ll need to implement properly when we connect your payment provider. Otherwise customers may expect those accounts to actually work.

🟢 5. The basic UI structure looks good

The live page already has:

* Buy Data
* Buy Airtime
* Reseller / Agent Hub
* Transactions
* Customer/Agent switching
* Wallet
* Virtual Account
* Online Payment
* MTN, Airtel, Glo and 9mobile
* Data plans
* Phone-number/network detection
* Agent pricing 

So the foundation is definitely there.

⚠️ One important thing

The biggest issue isn’t actually the appearance. It’s that the current site is still largely a frontend/demo system.

Before we call KHERLEED DATA a real VTU platform, we need to connect:

Customer → Account → Wallet → Payment gateway → Transaction database → VTU/Data API → Delivery → Transaction history → Receipt

And, as you previously chose, wallet funding should use option B: a small funding charge on deposits rather than you absorbing the payment fee.

So I would not redesign the whole thing yet. The UI is good enough to move to the next stage.     And I want the UI design to be luxury design like for Alrahuzdata design.
